## Checklist

- [ ] Schema validation passes (`pnpm vnkc validate-record --all examples`)
- [ ] Registry validation passes (`pnpm vnkc validate-sources`)
- [ ] Tests pass
- [ ] Vietnamese diacritics are correct
- [ ] No placeholder values (`"unknown"`, `""`, sentinel dates)
- [ ] Provenance metadata included where applicable
